annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministras, Ministros y Altas Autoridades de América Latina y el Caribe (Cumbre Ministerial, Santiago de Chile)
key_provisions_or_claims: Affirms human-rights-based approach to AI and endorses UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI as reference framework
States should develop national, regional and international AI policies, strategies and institutional frameworks
Countries to use UNESCO Readiness Assessment and Ethical Impact Assessment methodologies
Approves a Working Group toward an intergovernmental Council on AI for Latin America and the Caribbean
Chile leads the Working Group; UNESCO and CAF asked to support for two years
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Ministerial declaration from the October 2023 Santiago summit in which Latin American and Caribbean countries commit to human-rights-based, ethical AI governance anchored in the UNESCO Recommendation, and establish a Working Group, led by Chile, toward a regional intergovernmental AI Council.
annotation.title_clean: Declaración de Santiago: Para promover una inteligencia artificial ética en América Latina y el Caribe
annotation.title_en: Santiago Declaration: To Promote Ethical Artificial Intelligence in Latin America and the Caribbean
annotation.venue: Cumbre Ministerial y de Altas Autoridades de América Latina y el Caribe
